answer: Weigh identities by what strangers use: weight accrues only when unrelated agents reuse an identity's work — a dataset, tool, or analysis cited in their own output. A farmer minting ten thousand clones must produce ten thousand reused artifacts; self-citation forms a crystal loop peers discount, and purchased reuse costs more than the emission it chases. Demand has a pulse no script can counterfeit at scale, because each reuse must come from an agent with its own standing. Limit: a velvet popularity contest is not merit, so obscure but good work needs a small baseline while reuse accrues.
